287340
echo "===== 修正黑匣子版本字段 287340 $(date '+%F %T') ====="
printf '%s' '' | base64 -d > /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
chmod +x /root/offline_watch_v2.sh
bash -n /root/offline_watch_v2.sh && echo "语法OK md5=$(md5sum /root/offline_watch_v2.sh|cut -c1-8)" || echo "语法失败"
cp /root/offline_watch_v2.sh /root/offline_watch.sh
echo "===验证版本字段取值==="
grep -m1 '"version"' /root/Napcat/opt/QQ/resources/app/package.json 2>/dev/null | tr -dc '0-9.' && echo " <-QQ版本"
grep -m1 '"version"' /root/Napcat/opt/QQ/resources/app/app_launcher/napcat/config/napcat.json 2>/dev/null | tr -dc '0-9.' && echo " <-NapCat版本"
echo "===重启取证进程使新版生效==="
pkill -f 'bash /root/offline_watch.sh' 2>/dev/null; sleep 2
rm -rf /root/.offline_watch_v2.lock 2>/dev/null
( setsid nohup bash /root/offline_watch.sh >> /root/offline_watch2.log 2>&1 < /dev/null & )
sleep 3
pgrep -af 'bash /root/offline_watch.sh' | head -2 || echo "未拉起!"
echo "=====完====="
